evidence: In the 3D top and iso views the relay bodies K1-K4 abut the screw terminal bodies J1-J4 with no visible assembly gap, and the SMD driver passives sit nearly touching the top edges of the relay bodies.
All four screw terminals sit along the bottom board edge with wire openings facing outward and an unobstructed path between each terminal face and the edge in the 2D, 3D top, and iso views.

The four relay channels have identical driver-cluster layouts (D5/R5/Q1/D1 through D8/R8/Q4/D4) repeated at uniform pitch, with relays, drivers, and terminals each forming straight aligned rows in the 2D view.

In the 2D view the driver-cluster designators overlap each other and their pads (e.g. 'R R5', 'Q1 D1' rendered on top of the dense pad clusters), and the right-side L2/C2/C1/L1 labels sit directly on the components in that tightly stacked column.

The entire top third of the board and wide left/right margins are empty while the driver clusters are congested to near-touching, and the L2/C2/C1/L1 column is stranded at the far right away from any functional group.
